info.name: univ-v2-curriculum_employee
info.description:
Employee create/update + Curriculum CRUD + Exam Operations APIs.

**Docs:** `docs/postman/EMPLOYEE.md`

## Employee flow
1. `POST /employee/addEmp` → save `employeeId`
2. `PATCH /employee/{{employeeId}}`

## Curriculum flow
1. `POST /api/curriculums` (draft) → `curriculumId`
2. `POST /api/curriculums/:id/map-subjects`
3. `PATCH /api/curriculums/:id/publish` `{ "publishStatus": "published" }`
4. `POST /api/curriculums/:id/map-batch`

## Exam Operations
1. `GET /examOperations/rooms` — room-wise ops for an examination session

Set `baseurl` + `token`. Tenant from `saveUserDefaults`.

item.name: 2. Curriculum
item.description:
Mount: `/api/curriculums`

publishStatus: `draft` | `published`

Edge cases:
- Map subjects / unmap subject / update credit → draft only
- Publish needs ≥1 subject
- Map batch → published + active only
- Unpublish blocked if batches mapped
- Delete curriculum blocked if published or batches mapped
- Unmap batch blocked if students exist for course+batch
- Term rows auto-create/delete with batch mapping

Creates curriculum. Default publishStatus = draft. campus/institute from tenant.

Update name and/or isActive.

Edge case: cannot rename when published (unpublish first).

publishStatus: `draft` | `published`.

Edge cases:
- Already same status → 400
- Publish requires ≥1 subject mapped
- Unpublish blocked if batches mapped
Set publishStatus back to draft. Blocked if batch mappings exist.

Delete curriculum.

Edge cases:
- Blocked if published
- Blocked if batches mapped
- Subject mappings deleted in transaction
Map subjects to terms. Draft only. Subjects must belong to curriculum programme. Term ≤ totalTerms.
Update credit/term. Draft only.
Remove subject mapping. Draft only.

Map batch year to curriculum. Auto-creates term/year rows.

Edge cases:
- Curriculum must be published + active
- One curriculum per programme+batch → 409

Delete batch mapping. Term rows auto-deleted.

Edge case: blocked if students enrolled for that course+batch.

item.name: 3. Exam Operations
item.description:
Mount: `/examOperations`

Room-wise exam operations. Term filter uses `exam_schedule.term` (not `subject.term`). Course is paired via `subject.course_id`.

status: `READY_FOR_EXAM` | `NOT_READY`

query.description: Optional JSON array string. Each item: { courseSessionMappingId, terms[] }. Term filters exam_schedule.term; course from session mapping → subject.course_id.

request.description:
## GET /examOperations/rooms

Room-wise exam operations for an examination session.

### Auth
Bearer `{{token}}`

### Query

| Name | Required | Description |
|------|----------|-------------|
| examinationSessionId | Yes | Session id |
| examDate | No | YYYY-MM-DD |
| selections | No | JSON string: `[{ "courseSessionMappingId": 1, "terms": [1,2] }]` |
| status | No | `READY_FOR_EXAM` \| `NOT_READY` |
| page | No | Default 1 |
| limit | No | Default 10 |

### Filter notes (curriculum-aligned)
- `term` filtered on **exam_schedule.term** (not subject.term)
- `courseId` from session course mapping paired with term per selection
- Subject name/code still from `subject` table

### Response shape
- `rows[]`: one per room (`classRoomSectionId`)
- `operations[]`: per examDate + slot
- each operation: `status`, `exams[]`, `invigilators[]`, `materialBundle`
- `READY_FOR_EXAM` when invigilators + materialBundle both exist
Minimal call — only examinationSessionId required. No date/selections/status filters.

### Create Curriculum Category

Creates a new curriculum category.

#### Request Fields
| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `categoryName` | String (max 150) | Yes | - | Name of the curriculum category |
| `code` | String (max 20) | Yes | - | Unique identifier code (auto uppercase) |
| `isElectiveCoursework` | Boolean | No | `true` | Whether this category is elective coursework |
| `description` | String (max 250) | No | `null` | Optional description |

response.name: 201 Created Response
